blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Team Philippines’ Tenny Madis and Stefi Aludo rallied from a second-set deficit to beat Indonesia’s Anjali Junarto and Meydiana Reinnamah, 6-3, 7-6 (4), and advance to the tennis women’s doubles Round of 16 in the Asian Games 2026. Madis and Aludo controlled the opening set before taking an early 3-1 lead in the second, but Junarto and Reinnamah won four straight games to go up 5-3 and put the Filipinas in trouble.
